vocab.rosterLead: Former players, managers, coaches, Spurs Women and first-team players. Filter by role, topic or format, or search by name.
vocab.heroLead: The official way to book former Tottenham Hotspur players, managers, coaches and analysts for keynotes, after-dinner speaking, appearances, workshops and virtual events.
vocab.eraLead: From the old Lane to the new stadium, find the Spurs side you remember and book the people who built it.
vocab.eventStoryBody: A former head coach and two former players hosted a partner dinner at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium: welcome, Q&A and photos. (Illustrative example.)
vocab.squadLead: Current players are available for appearances and events, subject to the fixture list and training schedule.
vocab.beyondLead: Browse football and sports speakers on PepTalk.
vocab.waysLead: From a conference keynote to a guest appearance, pick the format that fits your event. Every booking is handled end to end by one bookings team.
vocab.aboutLead: brings former Tottenham Hotspur players, managers, coaches and analysts, plus Spurs Women and today’s first team, to conferences, dinners, workshops and events. Every speaker is put forward with the club and booked through one official service, so you get people who lived the moments, briefed for your audience.

keynote.title: Keynote & fireside chat
keynote.short: A headline talk or an interview-style conversation on leadership, pressure and resilience.
keynote.desc: A 30–45 minute talk, or an interview-style conversation with your host, built around your theme: leadership, pressure and resilience.

workshop.short: Hands-on sessions with managers and coaches on building high-performing teams.

virtual.short: Live online sessions and recorded video messages for teams anywhere.

cost.q: How much does it cost to book a speaker?
cost.a: Fees depend on the person, the format, the date and travel. Share your brief and the PepTalk bookings team will come back with an indicative fee.

travel.q: Can speakers travel outside London or abroad?
travel.a: Yes, most speakers travel across the UK and internationally. Virtual formats are available too.

faqOverrides.leadTime: Six to eight weeks is ideal. Availability depends on fixtures, media commitments and, for some speakers, current roles in football.
faqOverrides.current: Yes, for appearances and events. Current squad appearances are arranged with Tottenham Hotspur around the fixture list and training schedule, so allow extra lead time and expect limited dates.

eventSpaces.copy: Conferences, away days, launches and dinners in the stadium’s event spaces, with a Spurs speaker to open, host or close the day. Enquire directly with the stadium’s events team.
